description:
Advances: ancora.derive, ancora.gate

Findings: F1 (Critical, distributed C1), F4 (High, security H1), F24 rides along (Medium, data M2). Consensus CF1 in ~/vaults/rmbrs-vault/code_review/critical/ancora/2026-09-04/ancora-xla-post-ship-hardening/20260904-061300-consolidated.md.

Deliverable:
Two reproduced defects with one root cause: a git-supplied name is carried as an opaque string from the subprocess into a map key and a blob spec with no point where it becomes a validated relative path.
(a) `git diff --name-status` and `git status --porcelain` run without `-z` at lib/ancora/derive/change_set.ex:56-66 and :101-114, so any path git C-quotes (non-ASCII byte, space, tab, quote, backslash) is stored as the quoted literal. Against a repo containing lib/café.ex the change set holds "lib/caf\303\251.ex"; ModuleLocator.base_sources falls through to :unchanged so base == head and no drift can ever be detected; Compare.changed_definition? filters the binding out; `mix spec.check` prints result=pass. Silent fail-open.
(b) lib/ancora/git/batch_port.ex:164-180 parses git cat-file --batch's "<request> missing" reply by splitting on spaces, so a request spec containing a space is read as a malformed frame. One untracked file named "my notes.txt" flips `mix spec.check` from result=pass to an unhandled RuntimeError ("gate assembly failed: {:cat_file_batch_bad_header, ...}" raised at gate.ex:466) with no verdict line. Reproduced end to end at e18fa05. Loud fail-closed with no contract.
Fix: add `-z` to both git invocations and parse NUL-delimited records (which never quote); resolve change-set paths to object ids through the existing Git.ls_tree_entries/3 and fetch by OID in prefetch/2 (change_set.ex:81), matching what BaseView already does on this branch; tag Git.read_blob/2's second argument as {:path, p} or {:oid, o} and delete the 40/64-hex regex heuristic and read_spec/2 (git.ex:14, :90-92; this is F24 and it is required because the OID fetch makes the ambiguity live); parse the missing reply from its right-hand end; add a {:cat_file_batch_bad_header, _} clause to gate_error/1 so any residual bad frame reaches the operator as tier=env with a verdict line, never a stack trace. Backstop: refuse any path that still arrives wrapped in double quotes rather than storing it.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: test/ancora/derive/change_set_test.exs, test/ancora/git_batch_port_test.exs, test/ancora/git_test.exs, test/ancora/gate_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs
- Behaviors to demonstrate, each through a real git fixture and the real gate or CLI:
  1. An untracked file whose name contains a space: `mix spec.check` ends `spec.check result=pass` with exit 0 (today: RuntimeError, no verdict). Mutation the test must kill: restore the space-split parse.
  2. A changed lib/café.ex whose definition changed between base and head: the derived transition/drift finding fires (today: nothing). Mutation: drop `-z` from either git call; the test must fail.
  3. A committed file whose path contains a space, changed between base and head: prefetch resolves it by OID and the comparison sees the real base bytes. Mutation: fetch by path spec again; the test must fail.
  4. A malformed batch frame that still reaches the gate ends tier=env with a verdict line. Mutation: remove the gate_error clause; the test must fail.
  5. Git.read_blob/2 with {:path, <40 hex chars>} reads the path, not an object. Mutation: restore the regex; the test must fail.
- Spec edit required in-diff (substantive, not an acknowledgment): ancora.derive (change_set_union or base_reads_batched) shall state that change-set paths are read NUL-delimited, never stored quoted, and resolved to object ids before any blob read; ancora.gate (preflight_hard_fails or the env-tier statement) shall state that a malformed cat-file frame is an environment failure with a verdict line. Decision-record edit: an affects entry or Consequences note on ancora.decision.no_execution_no_state or a new ADR; name what changed.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: compile-graph-scoped checks only (`mix test --stale` or the named files) plus `mix spec.validate`; run `mix spec.check --base e18fa05` as a dev-loop check as soon as the spec edit exists, before either capped final-tier run.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`, the named test files, `mix format --check-formatted`, `mix deps.unlock --check-unused`, `mix spec.check --base e18fa05`, run-until-green. Full suite runs at the orchestrator's merge gate.
  - Verifier tier: `mix spec.check --base e18fa05` plus targeted selections; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test that fails under the named mutation; prove each ordered test both ways and report the numbers
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh: the substantive requirement or scenario edit named below lands in the same diff with its decision-record edit; never a Spec-Ack trailer; never weaken a must
  - Fixtures never call production functions (use test/support or System.cmd); under file-scoped derivation a stray call binds a subject
  - Grader scratch discipline applies to you too: work only in this worktree, address it by absolute path
- Call-site Integration: the production callers are ChangeSet.compute/1 and ChangeSet.prefetch/2 reached from Gate.check/2 and Review; the proving tests are the gate/CLI fixtures above, not unit tests of the parser alone.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/base_view.ex (F3, ancora-kzw, and F9/F36 on ancora-d16)
- lib/ancora/review/**, lib/ancora/parser.ex, lib/ancora/verifier.ex, lib/ancora/trailer.ex, lib/ancora/config.ex, lib/mix/tasks/**
Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/ancora/derive/change_set.ex, lib/ancora/git/batch_port.ex, lib/ancora/git.ex, lib/ancora/derive/module_locator.ex (only if the OID path forces a signature change)
- lib/ancora/gate.ex (gate_error/1 clause and the prefetch call site only)
- test/ancora/**, test/mix/tasks/**, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.derive.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (substantive edits named above; never weakening a must)
- Any .spec/specs/<subject>.spec.md that `mix spec.check --base e18fa05` names in a derived/drift, derived/growth or derived/shrink finding caused by THIS ticket's own diff (binding-aware clause: derivation is file-scoped, so acknowledgment edits only, one substantive sentence describing what this ticket changed as that subject observes it, verified by execution; if the subject observes nothing, say so in the completion record and stop)
- .spec/decisions/** (every spec edit requires a decision-record edit in the same diff; write a real contract statement, never a hollow line)

Out of Scope (intent):
- No constraint of entry paths to the materialization root (that is ancora-kzw; do not half-fix it here). No change to BaseView's read path. No new dependency. No change to the batch-port accumulation loop (F9, deferred). Do not rebase; base stays e18fa05.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes (`mix spec.check --base e18fa05` result=pass)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

Mutation proofs, each run alone: spaced missing-frame parser 1 failure mutated and 1 pass restored, UTF-8 path 2 failures for removing each -z flag and 1 pass restored, spaced-path OID prefetch 1 failure mutated and 1 pass restored, malformed-frame gate clause 1 failure mutated and 1 pass restored, 40-hex tagged path 1 failure mutated and 1 pass restored; the real CLI spaced-untracked fixture also passed 1 selected test.
